authorization: Build a separate approximate RL model (Recommended)
model: 3D central-force 26-neighbour elastic bond network; symplectic Euler; irreversible work-paid bond deletion

fracture.bond_area: h^2/9, exact planar-grid count only for grid-axis cuts; directional error must be measured
fracture.law: Blade bond-plane intersection plus finite edge/advance process zone. Irreversible work accumulated from resisting force and actual relative blade motion; no geometry-only removal. Elastic bond energy lost on deletion is separately recorded.
fracture.slicing_approximation: Irreversible work progresses with positive edge-normal motion + 0.25 times edge-tangent slip. Resistance direction follows total relative motion, and its magnitude enforces the same Gc*A work budget. Empirical provisional law; no measured calibration.

geometry.exterior: occupied lattice centers within convex hull of saved tomato exterior; not an exact reproduction of its continuum surface
geometry.knife: finite 120 x 30 x 1 mm rectangular blade proxy; differs from original CAD
geometry.mass: uniform per-node masses rescaled to saved 121.253418 g at scale 1; effective boundary density differs
geometry.contact: per-particle sphere/box and sphere/plane unilateral projection; world material represented as spheres plus massless bonds; no inherited whole-continuum penetration qualification

research_note: These sources establish relevant families of compliant constraints, cutting springs and task-learning simulators; none supplies or validates this specific network. Current pilot uses explicit springs, not XPBD.
repair: First cube pilot stopped at 2N before any failure because normal-only accumulation required penetration while sawing paid no damage work. One declared sawing-assisted damage correction is under bounded validation.
